title: 分液ロートによる液液抽出3Dシミュレーション
title_en: This is a 3D simulation interactive world of liquid-liquid extraction operable via browser and mobile
author: @Rucyinthefire
summary_zh: 这是一个液液抽出的三维模拟交互世界，可以在浏览器和手机端运行。用户可操作分液漏斗进行摇晃使两相乳化，再静置使其分层，同时观察溶质（色素）自水相向有机相迁移。界面实时显示各层体积、溶质质量和回收率。具备开阀放出下层液体的功能，并有过量放出警告。支持两次提取，溶质包含分配系数K=8的色素和K=40的碘类物质。
summary_en: This is a 3D simulation interactive world of liquid-liquid extraction operable via browser and mobile. Users manipulate the separatory funnel by shaking to emulsify phases, then allow settling to separate layers, observing solute transfer from aqueous to organic phase. The interface displays real-time volumes, solute mass, and recovery rates per layer. It includes a stopcock to drain the lower layer with over-drain warning and supports a second extraction. Solutes modeled are an orange dye with partition coefficient K=8 and an iodine-like substance with K=40.
workflow_steps_zh: ユーザーはブラウザやスマホで3Dシミュレーションを開く。
分液ロートを振って二相を乳化させる。
静置して二層に分離させる。
溶質が分配係数に従い下層の水層から上の有機層へ移動する。
ユーザーはコックを操作して下層を抜き取る。過剰に抜くと有機層混入警告が出る。
新しい溶媒を足して二回目の抽出を行うことも可能。
workflow_steps_en: User opens the simulation in browser or smartphone.
User shakes the separatory funnel to emulsify the two liquid layers.
User lets the mixture settle to separate into two layers.
The solute transfers from the aqueous lower layer to the organic upper layer according to partition coefficients.
User operates the stopcock to drain the lower aqueous layer, with warning if over-drain occurs causing organic contamination.
User may add fresh solvent and perform a second extraction.
evidence_quotes: Claudeに作ってもらった液液抽出の3Dシミュレーションです。分液ロートを振ると乳化して、静置すると2層に戻り、色（溶質）が下の水層から上の有機層へ移ります。各層の量と溶質のmg、回収率がその場で数値表示されます。
コックを開けて下層を抜く操作つきで、抜きすぎると有機層まで混入して警告が出ます。新しい溶媒を足して2回目の抽出もできます。
溶質は分配係数K=8の色素と、K=40のヨウ素風の2種類。

summary_zh: Claude Fable 5.2用一句97 KB的HTML文件构建了Abyssal Garden，这是一个可在浏览器中游泳穿越的水下世界，无需图片、3D模型、音频文件或库。海藻森林、沉船、魔鬼鱼和水面光线均由代码在加载时生成，运行于WebGPU，海床在GPU上塑形，包含约两百万片海藻叶子和植物。该作品免费且采用MIT许可，首个生成提示已公开于代码库。访问者可在浏览器中游泳探索该水下世界。
summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 built Abyssal Garden, an underwater world you can swim through in your browser, from a single 97 KB HTML file with no images, 3D models, sound files, or libraries. Kelp forests, a sunken ship, manta rays, and light rays from the surface are all generated by code on load. Runs on WebGPU, with the seabed shaped on the GPU and about two million kelp leaves and plants. The work is free and MIT-licensed, and the first prompt is public in the repository. Visitors can swim through this underwater world in their browser.
workflow_steps_zh: 使用Claude Fable 5.2生成一个单文件的水下世界HTML。
加载时由代码生成海藻林、沉船、魔鬼鱼和水面光线。
使用WebGPU渲染和GPU上的海床塑形。
程序化产生约两百万片海藻叶子和植物填充场景。
发布可在浏览器中游泳的HTML文件，采用MIT许可证。
首个生成提示公开于GitHub仓库。
workflow_steps_en: Use Claude Fable 5.2 to generate the underwater world as a single HTML file.
Generate all scenes including kelp forests, sunken ship, manta rays and light rays by code on page load.
Use WebGPU for rendering and seabed shaping on the GPU.
Populate the scene with about two million kelp leaves and plants generated procedurally.
Publish the HTML file for browser play and release under MIT license.
Make the first prompt for generation public in the GitHub repository.
skills_zh: Claude Fable 5.2生成提示（首个公开）
evidence_quotes: Claude Fable 5.2 built Abyssal Garden, an underwater world you can swim through in your browser, from one 97 KB HTML file with no images, 3D models, sound files or libraries.

title: Sacred Monkey Forest
author: @SammmAing
summary_zh: 一个基于真实游客地图的巴厘岛乌布圣猴森林的3D行走场景。包括三座寺庙、神圣泉水、跨峡谷的龙桥，2275棵树木和120只长尾猴。所有模型由脚本在Blender里生成，雕刻面具和雕像通过Hunyuan3D从照片转成3D。声音完全由代码生成，支持环境声和动态猴叫声。
summary_en: A 3D walkable recreation of the Sacred Monkey Forest in Ubud, Bali, following the real visitor map. Includes three temples, a holy spring, the Dragon Bridge over the ravine, 2,275 trees and 120 long-tailed macaques. Models (monkeys, temples, trees) scripted in Blender; carved faces and statues turned from photos into 3D with Hunyuan3D. All sounds are code-generated including environment and monkey calls placed spatially. Runs in browser using Three.js.
workflow_steps_zh: 由Samnang Aing指导完成，历时18天，经历19个版本迭代。
主要利用Claude Code (Opus 5.5) AI代理自动生成多数内容。
使用OpenAI Codex进行代码润色。
最后用Gemini 4 Argon完善猴子步态、时间变化、音效和界面。
在Blender中用Python脚本自动生成猴子、寺庙和树木模型。
利用本地Hunyuan3D 2.0由照片生成雕刻脸部和雕像3D形态，再导入Blender细化。
所有声音由Web Audio API动态编码实现，无音频文件。
使用Three.js r186和JavaScript构建整体场景，无框架。
定制50多个着色器实现水面、天空、树叶风动、湿石和苔藓等效果。
采用多级细节切换、视锥剔除和光照烘焙等技术优化性能。
资源约250MB，支持浏览器打开实时游览。
workflow_steps_en: Directed by human over 18 days and 19 versions.
Most content generated with AI agent Claude Code (Opus 5.5).
Polished with OpenAI Codex.
Final round (monkey walking, times of day, sounds, interface) done with Gemini 4 Argon.
Blender models scripted in Python for macaques, temples, trees.
Carved faces/statues created from photos via Hunyuan3D locally then refined in Blender.
All sound made in Web Audio API with no audio files.
Scene built as one JavaScript file using Three.js r186 without frameworks.
Advanced shaders used for water, sky, wind in leaves, wet stone, moss.
Models compressed with meshopt, textures in KTX2 format.
Performance optimized with level of detail (LOD), frustum culling, shadow baking.
Deployed for live browser use with about 250MB asset load.

title: Three.js Particle Fluids
author: @dangreenheck
summary_zh: 这是一个基于WebGPU的三维粒子物理库，使用three.js实现流体、软体、布料和气体的模拟与渲染。所有对象均以粒子形式表现，支持流体与软体、布料间的相互碰撞和动态交互，可以在一个场景中实现水流推动布料、软体漂浮混合于流体等效果。性能可调节粒子数量以适配不同设备。
summary_en: This is a WebGPU-based 3D particle physics library implemented with three.js, simulating and rendering fluids, soft bodies, cloth, and gases. Everything is represented as particles, enabling collision and interaction between fluids, soft bodies, and cloth in a single scene. It supports effects like water squirting onto cloth and pushing it back, cloth draping over objects, and soft bodies floating or mixing with fluids. Performance is adjustable via particle count for different devices.
workflow_steps_zh: 设置基于WebGPU的three.js渲染器。
创建Simulation实例，传入渲染器、场景、相机、容器边界盒和粒子数预算。
向模拟中添加定义的流体包围盒。
每帧调用step步进模拟并渲染场景。
调整粒子数以在不同设备上调优性能。
workflow_steps_en: Set up a WebGPU-enabled three.js renderer.
Create a Simulation instance specifying renderer, scene, camera, container bounding box, and particle count budget.
Add fluid volumes defined by bounding boxes to the simulation.
On each animation frame, step the simulation and render the scene.
Adjust particle count to tune performance across devices.
skills_zh: 利用Opus 5.5提升库的质量和完成度
evidence_quotes: GitHub SPDX: MIT
